lead: Former PDP national chairman and Gongola governor Bamanga Tukur died, and northern governors mourned him. INEC published the final list of presidential candidates and running mates for January 2027, and objected to Atiku Abubakar's bid to amend his suit against President Tinubu. Diphtheria reached Abuja with two deaths, Nigeria's envoy-designate said more than 30 Nigerians had been killed by South African police since 2022, and Kayinsola Ajayi ran 9.93 seconds to finish fourth in Budapest.

items.h: Bamanga Tukur, former PDP chairman and Gongola governor, dies
items.s: Alhaji Bamanga Tukur, the third civilian governor of the old Gongola State, former PDP national chairman and businessman, has died. Northern governors paid tribute to him.

items.h: INEC publishes final list of presidential candidates
items.s: INEC released the final list of presidential candidates and running mates for the January 2027 general election.

items.h: INEC opposes Atiku's request to amend suit against Tinubu
items.s: INEC objected to Atiku Abubakar's application to amend his suit seeking to disqualify President Tinubu and the APC, and asked the court to dismiss the case over Tinubu's certificates. The ADC warned INEC against delays in issuing voter cards in the North-West.

items.h: Diphtheria kills two in Abuja
items.s: The FCT Administration confirmed two deaths and five laboratory-confirmed diphtheria cases out of 15 investigated in the capital.

items.h: Envoy says South African police have killed over 30 Nigerians since 2022
items.s: Femi Fani-Kayode, Nigeria's ambassador-designate to South Africa, demanded justice for murdered Nigerians and said the country's patience is running thin.

items.h: Tinubu and Atiku clash over Dangote's caution on subsidy
items.s: President Tinubu and Atiku Abubakar gave opposing readings of the Dangote refinery's warning about reintroducing a fuel subsidy.

items.h: Dangote says refinery shares could rise from N525 to N10,000
items.s: Aliko Dangote projected that shares offered at N525 could one day reach N10,000. Stockbrokers' bodies urged investors to buy through registered brokers.

items.h: Air strikes kill more than 18 terrorists in Borno
items.s: The air component of Operation Hadin Kai said strikes killed over 18 terrorists and destroyed logistics hubs in Borno.

items.h: DSS arrests three over Ayilamo attack in Benue
items.s: Governor Hyacinth Alia praised the DSS for arresting three suspects linked to Thursday's attack on Ayilamo in Logo, which killed police officers and villagers.

items.h: Gunmen kill three herders and 50 cattle in Plateau
items.s: Three herders and about 50 cows were killed near Aloghom in Mangu, a day after another herder was killed nearby.

items.h: Kwara monarch dies days after rescue from kidnappers
items.s: The Onigbesi of Igbesi, Oba Moses Oyinloye Iwedunmoye I, died in hospital after being rescued from kidnappers who took him on 22 August.

items.h: Sokoto police appeal for calm after cleric is stabbed
items.s: Police warned against reprisals after Malam Musa Lukuwa survived a stabbing after Friday prayers and the alleged attacker was killed by a mob.

items.h: Ortom explains lending Obi a vehicle and faults Alia
items.s: Former Benue governor Samuel Ortom said he gave Peter Obi a vehicle for his aborted condolence visit to Yelewata, and accused Governor Alia of attacking opponents to divert attention from his record.

items.h: FCCPC and NMDPRA team up against oil price fixing
items.s: The competition commission and the downstream regulator agreed to tackle cartels, price fixing and market abuse in petroleum products.

items.h: NCAA fines RwandAir N15m over baggage complaint
items.s: The aviation regulator fined RwandAir for failing to resolve a passenger's damaged-baggage complaint within the required time.

items.h: Ajayi fourth in 100m final in Budapest
items.s: Kayinsola Ajayi ran 9.93 seconds to finish fourth, as the fastest African, in the men's 100m at the World Athletics Ultimate Championship, winning $25,000.

items.h: Shettima meets Okonjo-Iweala at BRICS summit
items.s: At the BRICS summit in New Delhi, Vice President Kashim Shettima reaffirmed Nigeria's support for the World Trade Organization in talks with its director-general, Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala.

items.h: CBN survey: low earners feel inflation most
items.s: About 68.4 per cent of Nigerians earning under N70,000 said inflation was high in August. Firms expect business confidence to rise to 36.1 points by February 2027.

items.h: Candidate substitution claims hit Bauchi APC
items.s: Some Bauchi APC Assembly candidates said their names were replaced after they won primaries, and reconciliation led by Yakubu Dogara stalled.

items.h: PRP rejects claims linking Bauchi candidate to banditry
items.s: The Peoples Redemption Party defended its Bauchi governorship candidate, Senator Shehu Buba, against allegations of links to banditry and kidnapping.

items.h: Haske leaves APC to run for Adamawa governor on APM ticket
items.s: Businessman Abdulrahman Haske resigned from the APC and became the Allied Peoples Movement's governorship candidate in Adamawa.

items.h: APC mocks opposition after Kwankwaso asks Atiku to step down
items.s: The APC ridiculed the opposition after NDC vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso urged Atiku Abubakar to withdraw.

items.h: Christian group asks Tinubu to drop re-election bid
items.s: The Christian Social Movement of Nigeria cited insecurity and hardship in urging President Tinubu not to seek a second term.

items.h: Tinubu's daughter mobilises market leaders for re-election
items.s: Iyaloja-General Folashade Tinubu-Ojo is building a grassroots campaign network across trading hubs for her father.

items.h: ADC chieftain urges South to back Atiku
items.s: Kenneth Imansuagbon said Nigeria needs a unifier and asked southern voters to support Atiku Abubakar.

items.h: Prophet El-Buba endorses SDP's Adebayo
items.s: Cleric Isa El-Buba backed Adewole Adebayo's presidential bid and his 2027-2031 policy blueprint.

items.h: Defence minister rallies support for Tinubu and Uba Sani
items.s: Christopher Musa urged Nigerians to back President Tinubu and Kaduna Governor Uba Sani in 2027.

items.h: Former military intelligence chief backs power rotation in Kogi
items.s: Vice-Admiral Joseph Ajayi (retd) said rotating the governorship would promote equity and unity in Kogi.

items.h: Rivers ADC says police disrupted meeting and arrested members
items.s: The ADC accused police and a local security committee of breaking up its meeting in Rivers.

items.h: Interior minister orders probe of second passport for Abuja realtor
items.s: The interior minister ordered an inquiry after lawyers alleged that a realtor obtained another passport after reporting hers missing.

items.h: Lagos police arrest seven over N24m extortion of traders
items.s: Lagos police arrested seven suspects from two fraud rings that allegedly targeted successful market traders and kept a list of 125 targets.

items.h: Anambra police arrest woman filmed assaulting a child
items.s: Police arrested a 36-year-old woman seen in a video assaulting a minor.

items.h: Police recover vehicle stolen from Edo ADC chairman's home
items.s: Edo police recovered one of two Toyota Highlanders taken in a robbery at the residence of state ADC chairman Kennedy Odion.

items.h: Abia invites public input on 2027 budget
items.s: The Abia government asked citizens and stakeholders to contribute to its 2027 budget proposal.

items.h: FMCG revenue stalls as inflation boost fades
items.s: Consumer goods firms' total revenue was nearly flat in the first half of the year as price increases slowed.

items.h: Trump hints US-Iran war may end; IEA counts 2.8bn barrels lost
items.s: President Trump signalled the conflict could be nearing an end, while the IEA estimated 2.8 billion barrels of exports lost through the Strait of Hormuz.
